from rest_framework.response import Response

from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import EnterpriseKnowledgeNode

diagnosis: The view looks up an EnterpriseKnowledgeNode (treebeard MP_Node) by node_id and dumps all descendant nodes using root_node.get_descendants(). It does not verify that root_node.organization == request.user.organization, enabling any user to dump private knowledge trees belonging to other companies.

from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.permissions import IsAuthenticated
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import EnterpriseKnowledgeNode

class KnowledgeSubtreeExportView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [IsAuthenticated]

    def get(self, request, node_id):
        root_node = get_object_or_404(
            EnterpriseKnowledgeNode,
            id=node_id,
            organization=request.user.organization
        )
        descendants = root_node.get_descendants()

        data = [{
            "id": node.id,
            "title": node.title,
            "content": node.content,
            "depth": node.depth
        } for node in descendants]
        return Response({"root_id": root_node.id, "nodes": data})
